spiritreceived.comments: When there was a call the play stopped for 2-3 minutes. We felt that the players didn’t want to resolve the problems quickly. Please pay much more attention to timing and communication when resolving calls!

Rules- Never call the double team and fouls by themselves, alot of comments from the coach from the sidelines, alot of interference. Not very knowledgable about the rules
Some of the calls that they made were unjustified, such as a few contact calls

1. you didn‘t know how to handle marking infractions/double teaming and the stopped which is unnecessary.
2. Discussions were too long. Players of your team involved themselfes which we mentioned to not do in pre-spirit circle.
Otherwise well played and congrats on the win! SUI X

There was alot of tough stops throughout this game, there was alot of poor communication to talk out calls even with translators. It seemed like they would yell at eachother to where one of our players saw one of theirs cry after being yelled at(allegedly not sure due to language barrier). We had issues with body contact and were unfamiliar with many rules, no major ones just the small things that began to add up.

we gave a 0 to fair mindedness because we felt that sometimes your players didn’t actually want to give their opinion on the calls, some of your players reacted in a nervous way towards our calls and we noticed that on the side there wasn’t a friendly attitude. Anyways, we felt that even if the game was a very tense one you kept your intensity high and we really appreciated that. good luck!

1. Foul call should be a stoppage. Fast count should not be a stoppage. In some instances there were certain calls that were unclear. Overall the rules could be touched up upon.
2. When marking the handler beware of the disc space as well as possible double teams. There were two or three instances of bumping and shoving on the field as well.
3. In one instance of a stall-out the player contested, but other players on the side heard the stall rise to ten. good luck in the rest of the tournament!!
We’ve had great game with you only few calls that were resolved very quickly and with respecting both teams thanks for the game see you in the future
Because of the not so good rule knowledge there were problems not only for called rules, but there communication as well. Lack of hand signals made it longer and harder to discuss the calls.
